content: चन्द्र {%a.%} [चन्द् णिच् रक्] <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Glittering, bright, shining (as gold). .²2 Lovely, beautiful. .{@-न्द्रः@} .²1 The moon; यथा प्रह्लादनाच्चन्द्रः <ls>R. 4. 12</ls>; हृतचन्द्रा तमसेव कौमुदी <ls n="R.">8. 37</ls>; न हि संहरते ज्योत्स्नां चन्द्रश्चाण्डालवेश्मनि <ls>H. 1. 61</ls>; मुख˚, वेदन˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; पर्याप्तचन्द्रेव शरत्त्रियामा <ls>Ku. 7. 26</ls> (for mythological account see सोम). .²2 The moon, as a planet. .²3 Camphor; विलेपनस्याधिकचन्द्र भागताविभावनाच्चापललाप पाण्डुताम् <ls>N. 1. 51</ls>. .²4 The eye in a peacockʼs tail. .²5 Water. .²6 Gold ({%n.%} also). .²7 A lovely or agreeable phenomenon .²8 A spot similar to the moon. .²9 The symbol or mark of a Visarga. .²10 A reddish kind of pearl. .²11 The fifth lunar mansion. .²12 The number ‘one’ (used at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> चन्द्र means ‘excellent’, ‘eminent’ or ‘illustrious’; as पुरुषचन्द्रः ‘a moon of men’, an excellent or illustrious man). .{@-न्द्रा@} .²1 Small cardamoms. .²2 An open hall only furnished with a roof. .²3 An awning, a canopy.
